source.summary: GitHub Actions 'Embedder footprint' runs for the PR #384 Codex review round-2 fix (branch fix/365-eq-face-identity at head cb4eb7c830e7b91c2669ef2886eebff6f59ec3b5 — the remaining traversals and comparisons that met an (eq) face now resolve it to the type it denotes: the borrow and memory-requirement traversals in the validator, the mixed primitive comparison in the runtime, annotated-name root normalisation, and the (eq …) ascription branch in the decoder) on top of the integrated #365 tree at d954c8f (ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45843366760, 45843388098 and 45843411918 against the branch produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series; the four core-jit series in this file are retained from PR #381's campaign (workflow_dispatch runs 45817815567, 45817829767 and 45817843974)
source.derivation: Re-baseline for the PR #384 Codex review round-2 fix (the remaining (eq) face traversals and comparisons resolve the face to the type it denotes), following the round-1 re-baseline at 6dba579 and the integration merge d954c8f. Attribution was isolated against the integrated tree itself: pull-request run 45831335741 measured the pre-fix head d954c8f in CI and passed the gate, and the round-2 fix commit cb4eb7c — the only change between the two heads — moves only the twelve series of the three configurations that link telomere-component: in release, stripped file +480 B (component, wasi) and +464 B (wasi-threads) and stripped .text +400 B on all three; in release-size, stripped file +256 B (component) and +272 B (wasi, wasi-threads) and stripped .text +208 B (component) and +224 B (wasi, wasi-threads). Every other series is byte-identical between the two heads. Against the checked-in baseline only the three release stripped file series grow (component +480 B, wasi +480 B, wasi-threads +464 B; every .text series and every release-size series measures at or below its retained baseline), so only those three series are re-baselined to the branch measurements and every other baseline is retained, following the established practice of re-baselining growth only. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples, and the pull-request run 45841060403 at the same head measured byte-identically once more. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +11.63% (2,433,656 B to 2,716,680 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Merge note for the integration with main cc6550bce007ca8d747160778aab6c3e41af272e (PR #381): the four core-jit series are retained from PR #381's second re-baseline campaign (branch runs 45817815567, 45817829767 and 45817843974; main control runs 45817858119, 45817871880 and 45817883664 on main at 2d653bfae0bd3ac995c17a0d26154f531762d28c), which re-baselined them for the #193 register mapping and the Codex P2 REX fix in movsx_vreg32; against the original #164 baseline those series stand at +8.32% (release stripped file, 1,989,584 B to 2,155,128 B), +7.48% (release stripped .text), +4.57% (release-size stripped file) and +4.24% (release-size stripped .text). The three release stripped file series of the component-linked configurations are from this PR's round-1 and round-2 campaigns, and every other series is identical in the campaigns' baselines, so the merged file is the union of the re-baselines.
